items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: It was an 8 track recording, I think it was Paul Winter I think was the artist actually. And I was assisting on the date.

ctx.x: Do you recall the first time you were asked to splice tape?

I do. Yeah actually, yeah. It was an 8 track recording, I think it was Paul Winter I think was the artist actually. And I was assisting on the date. And the engineer said, “Yeah put that together.” You know like that. “Put some splicing tape, and put that together.” And I thought oh man. So, and you do it. You do it, like any other craft you just learn how to do it.
You observe and listen and then —
